verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a `skills update` command that pulls the latest versions, and a `--list` preview that shows skill names and descriptions. Nothing shows release notes, changelogs or a diff of what changed in a skill before an update. Listing descriptions is an adjacent review feature and does not surface changes between versions, so the story's axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, releases ship with notes or a changelog so I can see what changed in the skills before I take an update
